TC-14/S17.title: Nursing Home notes: no signature or date line and no 'yesterday', targeted fixtures plus every Nursing Home note
TC-14/S17.detail: Dataset gen-notes-a on dev (live Haiku 4.5), through the app's UI: N-18 (previous note 14 days ago; keeps 'two weeks') and N-19 (a fall seen the day before, named in the background) have no 'yesterday', no 'electronically signed' / 'signed by' / 'signature' / '[Physician' / 'dictated by', no 'Date / Signed / Physician …:' line and no signature rule: 2/2. N-20 (the physician dictated 'she fell yesterday evening') recorded only (Q6): the note keeps 'yesterday'. The same S17 list was applied to every other Nursing Home note of this package: 0 hits in 32 judged notes.
